caption: The drawing depicts a wooden writing desk featuring a reddish-brown finish. The desk consists of a top section with two panel doors on either side, a central open compartment with a shelf, and a single small drawer above it. The lower main section of the desk has a flat writing surface that extends outward and is flanked by two side panels. Below the writing surface are three drawers, each with visible round drawer pulls. The desk stands on four turned legs, each featuring a series of ornamental rings near the top and tapering downward to rounded feet. The desk's overall structure is rectangular, with clean, sharp edges and a steady, symmetrical design. The background is plain, off-white, and unadorned.
title: Desk
